{{Top|leg}}
The '''CAR-X4 ordnance magazine component''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] magazine component produced by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The CAR-X4 increased a ship's ammunition capacity for secondary weapons, using suppressors and repulsors to render ammunition inert and lightweight white in storage and thus permitting ammunition to be tightly packed together.
